The analytics function of Harborline, a fictional retail bank: twelve functions, eight
models under one contract with an SR 11-7 style validation report each, a fraud desk
with late labels, a scorecard studio, fair lending on the public HMDA register, the
Federal Reserve's supervisory scenarios, and a general ledger that reconciles to the cent.

Every figure is in `RESULTS.md`, rendered from `results/manifest.json` by the claim gate,
which fails the build if a document and the data disagree. The site is at
https://mekala27-45.github.io/ledger/ and the reasoning behind every choice is in
`DECISIONS.md`.

Harborline Bank is fictional. This is a demonstration on generated data and public
datasets; no real customer, account or transaction of any real institution appears here.

Nothing here is a credit decision, a fraud determination, a suspicious activity finding
or investment advice.
